rule: CustomerID is required and unique within source
threshold_or_action: Reject missing ID or duplicate source key

rule: Phone is stored as +256 followed by nine digits when present
threshold_or_action: Normalize valid variants; quarantine invalid
enforcement: Form validation and nightly exception queue

rule: At least one contact method is supplied where lawful and operationally necessary
threshold_or_action: Phone or email required; record approved exception
enforcement: POS/app validation with supervisor override log

rule: Email syntax is valid and lower-case
threshold_or_action: Reject malformed values; preserve null

rule: District resolves to approved administrative reference
threshold_or_action: Reject unknown value; do not silently guess

rule: Date fields parse to ISO 8601 and are not future-dated
threshold_or_action: Reject future DOB/registration dates; log parse failure

rule: Exact-match candidate uses normalized phone+name or email
threshold_or_action: Auto-link only exact key with no attribute conflict; otherwise review
enforcement: MDM match service and audit log

rule: Enterprise product ID and active SKU are unique
threshold_or_action: Quarantine colliding source SKU; preserve both product IDs and aliases; steward assigns canonical code
enforcement: Master data API constraint and steward queue

rule: Unit belongs to controlled unit vocabulary
threshold_or_action: Map kg/KGS/Kilograms to kg; unknown goes to review
enforcement: Product form dropdown and ETL gate

rule: Category belongs to approved hierarchy
threshold_or_action: Reject unrecognized category; steward corrects taxonomy

rule: Transaction date is valid and within source extract watermark
threshold_or_action: Quarantine unparseable or out-of-window row

rule: Quantity is non-zero and return uses a negative quantity
threshold_or_action: Preserve signed quantity; flag unusual magnitude for review

rule: Currency uses ISO code and has an effective FX rate
threshold_or_action: Block unsupported currency; never sum mixed currencies raw

rule: Payment reference presence follows tender type
threshold_or_action: Missing-reference rate below 1% per mobile-money provider; investigate breach

rule: Source transaction ID is idempotent
threshold_or_action: Duplicate replay is ignored and counted

rule: Book and physical quantity counts share product unit and same cutoff
threshold_or_action: Variance above 2% or value threshold triggers recount

rule: Stock adjustment has reason code, approver, and evidence
threshold_or_action: 100% of adjustments carry approved reason and actor
enforcement: ERP required fields and audit report

rule: Only aggregate count is retained; no persistent person/device identifier
threshold_or_action: Reject payload containing face image or device ID
enforcement: Edge schema allow-list and privacy review

rule: Analytics copy masks national identifier and phone and bands salary
threshold_or_action: No direct ID or exact salary in analytics role
enforcement: Masking job plus column-level database grants

rule: Source counts and financial totals reconcile before publication
threshold_or_action: At least 99.5% row match and agreed amount tolerance; otherwise stop publish
